messages:
Aisha Carter: Morning team — quick standup for the desk. Queue snapshot: 38 open, 5 high, 2 escalations (one billing, one embeddings).

What I did: updated the 'embedding-failure' macro to include retry steps + owner assignment, reopened 2 stuck tickets from last night.
Blockers: need infra to confirm S3 permission change for the embeddings cache (tickets #1829 / #1830). Also waiting on CR review for the webhook fix (see PR).
Today: pair with @Max on the rollback play for embeddings, finish macro docs, and sweep high-priority queue at 10:30.

Max Nguyen: Can pair at 10:30 — I'll open the CR and add reviewers. PR: #4523. Also will drop a small sanity test for the webhook path.

Tess Coleman: Oncall — saw two alerts for embeddings (timeout spikes). I restarted the worker pool and pushed a config tweak to increase conn timeout from 3s -> 8s. Monitoring now. If it resurfaces we should failover to the cached embeddings endpoint.

Jared Lee: Merged a quick handler fix for the billing webhook, starting a canary. Logs looked noisy earlier: 429s on retry loop. Running `kubectl logs -f svc/webhook-handler --since=1h` showed the loop.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: webhook-handler v1.2.3 -> 10% traffic. Watch deployment: https://deploys.internal/redwood/webhook-handler/1.2.3

Aisha Carter: Macro update (short):
```
Title: embedding-failure
Body: 1) Confirm worker pool healthy; 2) Restart pool; 3) If persists, toggle embeddings-cached route and assign to @Tess; 4) escalate to infra if S3 perms error.
```
Please DO NOT use the old macro — it's been archived.

Max Nguyen: pinging @jared for CR review, left a comment about adding one more unit test. Also wrote a tiny smoke check you can run locally: `python tests/smoke_test_webhook.py --target=staging`

Jared Lee: on it, adding the unit test now. ETA ~25m. After that I'll promote canary if no errors.

Tess Coleman: Monitoring: errors down to baseline after restart. I'll keep watch for 30m then hand back to SRE. If anyone sees embeddings errors, add tag `embeddings-regression` so we can filter. :thumbsup:

Aisha Carter: Thanks. Quick asks:
- If you take a ticket from high, please drop a one-line status update.
- If you modify a macro, add the change to the macro PR and ping #docs for sync.

Max Nguyen: grabbing the high queue now. Will update tickets 3891 / 3892 with status.

Jared Lee: unit test added and green locally. Promoting canary to 50% in 10m if CI stays green.

Tess Coleman: noted — leaving a watch on alerts.

Aisha Carter: Cool — wrap up notes: queue 38 -> target <30 by EOD, escalations owned. If infra can't confirm S3 perms within 2 hours, escalate to platform leads. Thanks team. :wave:
